decided: 2026-09-12, Ben: rebuild the fact model as layered components
purpose: A fact is a headline plus an ordered tree of verbatim components. The reader sees the headline first and descends by click. Each layer is comparable across deals at that layer.

fields.fact_id: stable identity, unchanged from PRODUCT_PROPOSAL identity rules
fields.headline: object: { label, distinguishing_component_ids }
fields.components: ordered array of component objects; the top layer of the tree
fields.coverage_only: boolean; true for families the reader does not see (boilerplate)

fact.headline_rule: label is a controlled term from the V2 schema for the subtype; distinguishing_component_ids point at the components whose text distinguishes this provision from its counterpart in another deal (threshold, carve-out, standard, trigger, party). The rendered headline is the label followed by the distinguishing components' verbatim text. Topic alone is not a headline.

fields.component_id: sha256 of fact_id, path and text
fields.label: controlled short label for the layer, e.g. 'resulting from', 'war', 'threshold'
fields.text: verbatim contiguous source text, no normalisation, no ellipsis
fields.source_span_id: closure component span containing the text
fields.start_byte: UTF-8 offset in canonical text, half-open
fields.end_byte: UTF-8 offset in canonical text, half-open
fields.origin: one of origins: where the words come from
fields.origin_structure_node_id: structure node the words belong to (for CHAPEAU, INTRO, DEFINITION origins)
fields.gap_before: boolean; true when words were skipped between the previous sibling's end and this text; rendered as [...]
fields.value: optional { canonical, unit } for THRESHOLD, PERIOD, PERCENTAGE, DATE, AMOUNT
fields.members: optional array of verbatim strings; only for LITANY
fields.resolves_to: optional { structure_node_id, fact_id|null, text } for CROSS_REFERENCE
fields.children: ordered array of components; the next layer down

rules: R1 Every component text is a contiguous verbatim substring of its source span, checked by byte offsets; a component that fails is INVALID and the fact is held.
R2 Children are in source order. A LIST has one LIST_ELEMENT child per element that could vary between deals; nested lists nest ('including cyber-attacks' is a child of 'sabotage').
R3 A LITANY is one component; its synonyms are members, never separate components ('any event, change, circumstance, occurrence, effect or state of facts').
R4 Inherited words carry origin CHAPEAU, INTRO or DEFINITION and origin_structure_node_id. Rendering marks them; a fused statement is never shown as one sentence without [...] at each gap.
R5 No role or component is forced. A missing timing, qualification or forum is absent, not invented. The words 'none', 'not applicable' and section references never appear as component text.

R6 PERCENTAGE and AMOUNT components carry a canonical value parsed by code from the verbatim text, never by the model. THRESHOLD, PERIOD and DATE carry one when the words contain a number, a period or a date; a descriptive threshold, period or date ('at least equal to the number of Parent Ordinary Shares subject to the Assumed RSUs', 'on the second Business Day following the satisfaction of the conditions') carries value null.

R7 A CROSS_REFERENCE component resolves to the referenced node and, when the referenced provision has a fact, to that fact. Bring-down tiers resolve each referenced representation to its heading words.
R8 Every covenant fact has an EFFORTS_STANDARD component (flat obligation recorded as the verb phrase, e.g. 'agrees to take') and a MATERIALITY_QUALIFIER component when present.
R9 A fact's components together cover the fact's operative words; words not covered by any component are reported as an uncovered gap for review.
R10 The V1 statement and roles are retained on the fact for comparison during Phase 5B and removed from the reader view.

rendering.layer_n: the components at that depth, each clickable when it has children, inherited words marked, [...] where gap_before is true
